# Weapon/Idol Combat VFX Infrastructure Pass — Operator Packet

Role: Claude read-only Operator. Codex is Validator. This is an operator artifact for Codex validation, not a review greenlight. No files were edited, no shell/Unreal/editor runs were performed. Line anchors are from the working tree at read time and should be re-resolved by the Validator.

## 1. Current-State Summary

The combat VFX system has exactly one promoted production weapon-base binding (`Hero_1_black_aoe` → `NS_Hero1AxeAOE_MeshSlash` via `DT_CombatVFXBindings`); the other three weapon categories (Pierce/Bounce/DOT) exist only as infrastructure packets with no production binding rows, and all four idol category proofs (Water/AOE, Light/Pierce, Electric/Bounce, Poison/DOT) are structural/runtime proofs that spawn reused placeholder primitives rather than authored idol Niagara art. The idol impact lane is implemented generally — it switches on `FIdolData.Category` and publishes a category-neutral `CombatImpactChainDiagnostic` keyed by `SourceID` — but it is wrapped in a layer of Water-era naming and triple-duplicated hardcoded proof-idol allowlists that no longer match what the code does. The cheapest, lowest-risk wins are behavior-preserving renames (kill the "Water"/"WaterPlaceholder" vocabulary that Codex already flagged) and de-duplicating the three independent idol lists; everything that touches damage geometry, falloff, delay timing, allowlist membership, or placeholder scale is a behavior change and is explicitly out of cleanup scope.

## 2. Inventory Table

| Item | Class | Anchor | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Hero_1_black_aoe` → `NS_Hero1AxeAOE_MeshSlash` weapon-base binding | Production | `Content/Data/CombatVFXBindings.csv`; dispatcher `T66CombatComponent.cpp` (`CombatVFXProductionSpawned`) | Only promoted production VFX binding. |
| Pierce/Bounce/DOT weapon categories | Proof-only / infra | `VFX_PROCESS_INDEX.md:29-31` | Packet-only; no production binding rows. |
| Four idol category proofs (Water/Light/Electric/Poison) | Proof-only | `T66CombatComponent.cpp:3446-3697` (category switch) | Runtime + log + video proof; APPROVE’d by `codex_validator_report.md`. |
| `UsesImpactPresentationForIdol` allowlist (4 idols) | Scaffolding (proof gate) | `T66CombatComponent.cpp:2166-2179` | Hardcoded TSet gating WHICH idols enter the lane; comment says proof-phase only. |
| `SupportedProofIdols` set (5 idols, incl. Earth) | Scaffolding (proof gate) | `T66PlayerController_Overlays.cpp:3366-3372` | Second hardcoded idol list, must stay in sync with the first. |
| `New-CategoryNativeCase` + case array (5 cases) | Scaffolding (proof gate) | `RunHero1AxeIdolCategoryNativeImpactProof.ps1:47-113` | Third hardcoded idol list; required/forbidden pattern strings. |
| `SpawnIdolImpactPlaceholderVFX` (Pierce/Bounce/DOT) | Placeholder | `T66CombatVFX.cpp:1319-1412` | Reuses base `SpawnPierceVFX`/`SpawnBounceVFX`/`SpawnDOTVFX` primitives in idol color. |
| `SpawnWaterIdolImpactPlaceholderVFX` (AOE blue marker) | Placeholder | `T66CombatComponent.cpp:3673` | Compact fixed-scale marker, not an area read (see pending_issues `[Major]`). |
| Temporary projectile lane (`SpawnWeaponProjectileVisual`, `FT66TemporaryProjectileSystem`) | Placeholder | `T66CombatComponent.cpp:2181-2229`; `MASTER_COMBAT.md` | Blue placeholder visuals; suppressed for impact-presentation idols. |
| Log reason `Reason=ImpactPresentationOwnsWaterPlaceholder` | Temporary name/log | `T66CombatComponent.cpp:3184` | Codex-flagged; functionally harmless, category-misleading. |
| `Water*` local vars / `bWaterContextParity` / `bTouchedWaterImpactDiagnostics` | Temporary name | `T66CombatComponent.cpp:3327-3343, 3699-3760` | Water-named but now category-general counters. |
| `CombatIdolImpactDiagnostic SourceID=Idol_Water WaterIdolContextParity=...` | Temporary name/log | `T66CombatComponent.cpp:3744-3759` | Aggregate line hardcodes `Idol_Water` even when Water not equipped; the contract's "Water-only field" to map. |
| Capture mode `hero1axeaoewateridolimpact` / flag `bWaterIdolImpactProofMode` / arg `-T66Hero1AxeAOEProofIdol` | Temporary name | `T66PlayerController_Overlays.cpp:3204,3227,3364`; `CaptureT66GameplayVideo.ps1:36,205-206` | Mode drives all four categories; name still says Water. |
| Proof HP override `20000.f`; deterministic item grants (`660100+`) | Scaffolding | `T66PlayerController_Overlays.cpp:3419, 3460-3466` | Automation-only; not in normal gameplay. |
| `CombatVFXBindings.csv` / `DT_CombatVFXBindings.uasset` untracked by git | Validator gap | `CombatVFXInfrastructureInventory.md:302` | Live generated; not in `git ls-files`. Inspect directly. |
| Alignment contract not validator-enforced | Validator gap | `pending_issues_Combat.md:73-78` | Validator does not parse alignment blocks / tolerance. |
| Impact-context contract not validator-enforced | Validator gap | `pending_issues_Combat.md:80-85` | Generalized chain schema not parsed; legacy Water fields unmapped. |
| Production validator is Hero 1 AOE-specific | Validator gap | `CombatVFXInfrastructureInventory.md:182, 312` | No generic Pierce/Bounce/DOT structural validator. |
| Lab actor deprecated Niagara readiness API | Validator gap / known issue | `CombatVFXInfrastructureInventory.md:240-242` | Tracked in `pending_issues_Gameplay.md`. |

## 3. Prioritized Cleanup Plan

### Phase 1 — Behavior-preserving code naming/structure cleanup
1. Rename log reason `ImpactPresentationOwnsWaterPlaceholder` → category-neutral (e.g. `ImpactPresentationOwnsIdolLane`). Codex explicitly requested this (`codex_validator_report.md:96`). Pure string; verify no proof runner greps for the old token (`RunHero1AxeIdolCategoryNativeImpactProof.ps1` keys on `CombatVFXIdolProjectileLaneSuppressed SourceID=`, not the reason — confirm). `T66CombatComponent.cpp:3184`.
2. Rename Water-prefixed category-general locals (`ExpectedWaterIdolImpactContexts`, `WaterIdolImpactContextCount`, `WaterIdolSkippedNoWeaponContext`, `WaterIdolSkippedInvalidImpactPoint`, `WaterIdolLegacyFallbackCount`, `bWaterContextParity`, `bTouchedWaidolImpactDiagnostics`) to `Idol*`/category-neutral. Local scope only. `T66CombatComponent.cpp:3327-3760`.
3. Rename the `UsesImpactPresentationForIdol` lambda comment + the misleading "Water placeholder" framing without changing the allowlist membership (membership change = behavior, see §4). `T66CombatComponent.cpp:2161-2179`.
4. De-duplicate the three independent hardcoded idol lists into one shared declaration (proof-idol → category map) so the runtime allowlist, the overlay `SupportedProofIdols`, and the runner cases cannot drift. Structure-only; keep identical membership/behavior. `T66CombatComponent.cpp:2172`, `T66PlayerController_Overlays.cpp:3366`, `RunHero1AxeIdolCategoryNativeImpactProof.ps1:69-113`.
5. Map the aggregate `CombatIdolImpactDiagnostic SourceID=Idol_Water WaterIdolContextParity=...` to category-neutral field names (per contract §"Generalized Chain Diagnostic Schema"), or remove it as redundant with the per-idol `CombatImpactChainDiagnostic`. Needs-decision flag: it currently hardcodes `Idol_Water` even for non-Water idols, which is misleading but log-only. `T66CombatComponent.cpp:3744-3759`.

### Phase 2 — Proof runner / validator hardening
1. Rename capture mode `hero1axeaoewateridolimpact` / flag `bWaterIdolImpactProofMode` / arg `-T66Hero1AxeAOEProofIdol` to category-neutral (e.g. `hero1axeidolcategoryimpact`). Cross-file rename touching `T66PlayerController_Overlays.cpp`, `CaptureT66GameplayVideo.ps1`, the runner, and any docs — keep one alias pass and update all three call sites atomically. Behavior-neutral but cross-cutting.
2. Add validator enforcement of the generalized impact-chain diagnostic schema and map/retire the legacy Water-only field (`pending_issues_Combat.md:80-85`).
3. Generalize the structural validator beyond Hero 1 AOE so Pierce/Bounce/DOT get reusable carrier/source-guard checks and a reportable output (`CombatVFXInfrastructureInventory.md` Workstream 3).
4. Bring `CombatVFXBindings.csv`/`DT_CombatVFXBindings.uasset` git-tracking under a deliberate decision (track vs. documented-generated), since narrow git status currently hides them (`CombatVFXInfrastructureInventory.md:302`).

### Phase 3 — Docs/process consolidation
1. Update `VFX_PROCESS_INDEX.md:29-32` baseline rows: idol overlays now have four runtime category proofs (not just a Water placeholder example) — record them as proof-only, no production art.
2. Resolve/replace the Water-only "Worked Reference" vocabulary in `CombatVFXImpactContextContract.md:182-192` with the now-existing category-native examples.
3. Reconcile the `Hero1AxeVFXPlan.md` `vfxlab` Step 0.5 mode note vs. live capture modes (`CombatVFXInfrastructureInventory.md:153-155`).
4. Link `CombatVFXInfrastructureInventory.md` from an index if it is to be a first-read artifact (its own finding #8).

### Phase 4 — Deferred production art/content
1. Author production idol Niagara per category through `CombatVFXVisualDamageAlignmentContract.md`; replace `SpawnIdolImpactPlaceholderVFX` / Water blue marker (`pending_issues_Combat.md:66-71`).
2. Add `IdolModifier` production binding rows so `TrySpawnBoundIdolImpactVFX` resolves instead of falling back to placeholders.
3. Promote Pierce/Bounce/DOT weapon-base production bindings + visuals.
4. Final Hero 1 AOE visual-polish re-entry (`pending_issues_Combat.md:44-49`).

## 4. No-Touch List (behavior changes — NOT cleanup)

Do not alter these under the banner of cleanup; each is a gameplay/behavior change requiring its own reviewed gate (label deferred or needs-user-decision):
- Allowlist MEMBERSHIP of `UsesImpactPresentationForIdol` / `SupportedProofIdols` (which idols enter the impact lane). Renaming is fine; adding/removing idols changes behavior. `T66CombatComponent.cpp:2172`.
- Idol AOE `AoeDelay` immediate application (`DelayApplied=false`). `T66CombatComponent.cpp:3660`; `pending_issues_Combat.md:51-57`.
- `AoeInnerRadiusRatio=0.54` crescent for `Hero_1_black_aoe`; other AOE rows at `0.00`. `CombatVFXInfrastructureInventory.md:278`.
- Annulus-midpoint impact-context bridge for frontal hollow-crescent AOE. `pending_issues_Combat.md:59-64`.
- Category damage shaping: Pierce falloff default `0.15` + `MaxPierceTargets = property+1`; Bounce falloff default `0.2` + `BounceCount = property+1`; DOT duration/tick defaults. `T66CombatComponent.cpp:3461-3466, 3515-3516, 3585-3588`.
- Readable playback clamp `0.20s`. `CombatVFXInfrastructureInventory.md:279`.
- Placeholder marker scale / blue-sphere read — do NOT "fix" to a full area read; that is deferred production art. `pending_issues_Combat.md:66-71`.
- Automation HP override `20000.f` and deterministic item grant IDs. `T66PlayerController_Overlays.cpp:3419, 3460`.
- `SpawnWeaponProjectileVisual` idol-overlay suppression logic. `T66CombatComponent.cpp:3173-3212`.

## 5. Key Anchors

- Impact-presentation allowlist: `Source/T66/Gameplay/T66CombatComponent.cpp:2166`.
- Lane suppression + Water-named reason: `T66CombatComponent.cpp:3177, 3184`.
- Per-idol generalized diagnostic emitter: `T66CombatComponent.cpp:3337-3373`.
- Category switch (Pierce/Bounce/DOT/AOE): `T66CombatComponent.cpp:3446, 3509, 3579, 3621`.
- Aggregate Water-named diagnostic: `T66CombatComponent.cpp:3744`.
- Placeholder VFX dispatch: `T66CombatVFX.cpp:1319`.
- Proof idol selection + supported set + target specs: `T66PlayerController_Overlays.cpp:3361-3584`.
- Capture script idol args: `Scripts/CaptureT66GameplayVideo.ps1:36, 205-206`.
- Proof runner cases/patterns: `Scripts/RunHero1AxeIdolCategoryNativeImpactProof.ps1:47-132`.
- Validator approval + rename caveat: `Reports/AgentReviews/IdolCategoryNativeImpact/codex_validator_report.md:19-50, 96`.
- Validator-enforcement gaps: `Gameplay/Combat/pending_issues_Combat.md:73-85`.
- Untracked binding assets: `Gameplay/Combat/CombatVFXInfrastructureInventory.md:302`.
